newsitem.title: UK: BA continues talks for super jumbo jet.
newsitem.headline: BA continues talks for super jumbo jet.

text.p: British Airways Plc on Monday said it is in discussions with Airbus and Boeing as well as engine manufacturers in its efforts to achieve the development of a super jumbo jet.

"In the longer term British Airways requires larger longhaul aircraft with a seating capacity of 500 to 600 and is in discussions with Airbus, Boeing and engine manufacturers to achieve this," British Airways said in a statement.
"The discussions are ongoing," a British Airways spokeswoman told Reuters. "We are committed to looking at this longer, larger aircraft because we believe that this is where the industry is going."
The spokeswoman declined to be more specific.

British Airways on Monday confirmed existing orders for 10 Boeing 747-400 jets and said it also placed four new orders for 747-400s and excersied existing options on three long-range B model 777-200s.
